Population increased in West Midlands (county)

The estimated population of West Midlands (county) in 2024 was 3,036,605 usual residents, a rise of 1.4% since 2023.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of West Midlands (county) increased by 4.1%.

Age profile of West Midlands (county)

The average (median) age fell to 36.3 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of West Midlands (county) has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
By age category, West Midlands (county)'s population of 3,036,605 usual residents was made up of:

  • 643,336 people aged 0 to 15 years, (21.2%)
  • 1,926,526 people aged 16 to 64 years, (63.4%)
  • 466,743 people aged 65 years and over, (15.4%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, West Midlands (county) has a slightly lower proportion of people aged 65 years and over (15.4% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In West Midlands (county), the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in West Midlands (county)
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for West Midlands (county), between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 9,231 people (0.3%). In total, there were 35,528 births and 26,297 deaths in West Midlands (county).
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 28,112 (-0.9%). There were 101,426 people entering the area and 129,538 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in West Midlands (county)'s population of 61,417 (2.1%) as a result of 90,897 people entering the area and 29,480 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for West Midlands (county) was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of West Midlands (county) in mid-2023 is 2,994,216.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 11,336 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 1,946 people.

In the 'other change' category (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners), we have revised the 2023 figure downwards by 2 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 13,280 people.
